cornkkob: Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob came up with a draft of replacements on Day 3. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into S-F6. Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob has learned to walk bent double.
Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F6. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple).

The medics cleaned Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F6. A letter from home found Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob before the night shift. Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob folded it small and kept it close.
gremlin_jngaf: Konrad Jngaf arrived at R-F15 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Volunteer number 77. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Konrad Jngaf's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Orders came through: Konrad Jngaf is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a key to a house that is no longer there.
Konrad Jngaf repaired the strap on Jakub Ebrrrvole's pack. Payment was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Konrad Jngaf was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked. After the loss of Verdel Ridge, Konrad Jngaf helped stack spare sandbags at R-F15. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
On a quiet night Konrad Jngaf (Hegemony) and Benedikt Jakubwilkuu (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
A crow sat on the parapet above Konrad Jngaf all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
kjellx25: Silas Kjellx told the sergeant he was a brewer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Silas Kjellx and Wendel Jesus carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
tyleraldridge45: The new rifleman gave his name as Tobias Tyleraldridg. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
wubbarn: The new sapper gave his name as Florian Wubbarn. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Wendel Jesus and Florian Wubbarn made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier.
